sections_in_order: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale, page 1-2 (about 30 lines), definitions on p.2 change meaning of 'Functional or Physical Impairment' and 'Optimal Medical Therapy'. Pages 3-20 are evidence.

logic.top_level: all (indication AND CT/MRI rules out other causes AND none of six exclusions)

k_of_n.quote: for the following indications: Osteoporotic VCF; Steroid-induced vertebral fracture; Osteolytic metastatic disease; Multiple myeloma; Vertebral Hemangioma with aggressive features; Unstable fractures due to Osteonecrosis

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Block 'The following are not present:' with six items joined by 'or' (cord compression, collapse <1/3, healed VCF, sacrum/coccyx lesions, asymptomatic VCF, VCF responding to conservative therapy).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The following are not present: ... or ... or ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'not present' with 'or' means none of them; reading 'not (A or B)' vs '(not A) or (not B)' matters

and_or_ambiguity.quote: within 4 months of pain onset, that has failed to respond to Optimal Medical Therapy for the following indications
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Modifiers attach to pain; unclear whether 4 months applies to hemangioma/metastatic disease

and_or_ambiguity.quote: and Computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has ruled out other causes of spinal pain, including but not limited to
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'including but not limited to' is open-ended

requirement_kinds.quote: treating pain causing Functional or Physical Impairment

Osteoporotic vertebral compression fracture (VCF); Steroid-induced vertebral fracture; Osteolytic metastatic disease; Multiple myeloma; Vertebral Hemangioma with aggressive features; Unstable fractures due to Osteonecrosis

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Treatments that are used as first line before moving to more invasive, risky, or complex procedures (Gibbons and Miller, 2017).
significantly limited, impaired, or delayed capacity to move, coordinate actions, or perform physical activities

vague_terms.problem: Defined circularly; no modalities or duration

vague_terms.quote: VCFs responding appropriately to conservative therapy
Other significant coexistent spinal or bony pain generators

extraction_hazards: Coverage Rationale uses 'and' on its own lines to join three blocks
'or' at end of bullets in the not-present list
Definitions section is required to interpret criteria
Community Plan version: 05/01/2026 revision removed facet arthropathy and other spinal degenerative disease from the CT/MRI list and added documentation language (per Policy History)
interesting_structures: Four-month ceiling from pain onset (an upper bound on time, unlike peers that need a minimum wait)
No minimum number of weeks of conservative care; instead 'failed to respond' to optimal therapy
One policy for both procedures with a single set of criteria

fit_to_tree.why: Explicit all/any/not; strained by 'Optimal Medical Therapy', open-ended 'including but not limited to', and the NOT-present or-list reading.
